_doc: Where fork-tests.yml's Linux jobs run: this repository's own fleet of self-hosted runners, or GitHub-hosted.
The one place for every fact about this repository and its fleet: .github/scripts/fork-fleet.py has none.
Read by `route` (a step of fork-tests.yml's changes job), `watch` (fork-tests.yml), `sweep` (fork-fleet.yml),
and on each fleet host by `dispatch` and `gate` (an installed copy of main's script and of this file).
The setting is the repository variable named in `variable`: auto (unset too), fleet or github.
Runbook, owner steps and the failure table: .github/fork-fleet.md.
Upstream's code runs on GitHub-hosted runners only (owner decision). The daily sync pushes main with the owner's
token, so its push run would pass `trusted`: scripts/fork-follow-push.sh tags each commit it moves main to as
<tag_prefix><sha> before the move, and a push run of a tagged commit never uses the fleet. Keep the tags: a
run can be re-run for 30 days.
